canada.title: LED wands to light way for school patrols
canada.summary: Lightsaber-like wands are being handed out to school crossing guards in southeast Winnipeg to improve visibility during increasingly dark morning drop-offs due to Manitoba’s new time zone.

canada.title: Regina city council tables decision on Co-op refinery work camp proposal
canada.summary: Workers and concerned citizens came together at Regina city council to urge the city to not allow a proposed workcamp the Co-op refinery wants to build. Council tabled the motion until 2027, citing unanswered questions.

canada.title: InFocus: Is adopting permanent daylight saving time a mistake?
canada.summary: Many of us know how we feel when it's time to change our clocks. Some provinces and territories have put a stop to it. But is it a good idea?

canada.title: Alberta has tabled a bill for new riding maps. What could a court challenge mean?
canada.summary: Alberta’s controversial new riding map is one step closer to implementation after Justice Minister Mickey Amery tabled a bill in the legislature on Monday. But legal experts say a potential court challenge could introduce a high level of uncertainty in advance of the next provincial election.

canada.title: Coroner's inquest to look into 2021 death of man in Rankin Inlet, Nunavut
canada.summary: Trey Angootealuk, 22, died in November 2021, following what police described as a shooting incident involving RCMP.

canada.summary: The NDP says the changes are an attempt to rig the 2027 election, while the UCP says it's about boosting effective representation and that hybrid ridings already exist in Alberta.

lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
With the busiest travel season ahead, how likely is it that another FAA ground stop happens?, The Canadian Press reports.
St. John’s woman once again charged with fraud — this time involving Elizabeth Fry Society, CBC News reports.

United Airlines said Monday that it had resolved a technology issue that delayed departing flights, just days after a malfunction in the Federal Aviation Administration’s network prompted a nationwide ground stop, The Associated Press reports.
Stocks tumble on Wall Street as Nvidia leads another sell-off in technology companies, The Canadian Press reports.

Lindsay Clancy, the Massachusetts mother whose highly divisive murder trial shone a global spotlight on postpartum mental health, will be tried again on murder charges for the killings of her three children, CBC News reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
